metadata.note: A CLI-explainer weekly recap -- a NEW week's log, separate from the earlier recaps (weekly-recap-quota and before). Same story spine as those builds (B00 cold open -> problem -> ask -> code -> output -> change -> code -> output -> lesson -> handoff -> outro; real code shown via ClaudeCodeBeat; one required revision cycle). weekly_recap_v1.py and weekly_recap_v2.py are genuine Python scripts, both actually run; v1 is a flat list of four parts, v2 adds the user's ROLE to each (author / producer / support / organizer) and prints a done-vs-supporting count -- chosen because the user asked for a professional, honest update that says they HELPED Yatra with the poster rather than led it. THE POSTER DESIGN IS NOT DESCRIBED beyond 'I helped with it' (user instruction): the poster graphic is an abstract frame of geometric blocks and carries the user's required label, 'Poster design for the Homes of Hope documentary (with Yatra)'. HOMES OF HOPE VISUALS ARE ABSTRACT (user instruction): no photos, no children, no people shapes. NO real platform logos: the Substack article is a mock header (text kicker only), GitHub is a generic code-folder icon and Drive a generic cloud-folder icon, each with a plain-text label. Video count: the user's kickoff says 'four videos' and then clarifies 'two videos, each in two formats' -- this recap uses that wording exactly (two videos: this week's AI topic video and this recap; 16:9 and 9:16 each; four files in total). Disclosed substitutions carried forward: (1) af_bella + @HumanitariansAI instead of the skill's default voice/handle; (2) rendered through run.sh/compile.py/static_scene_check.py/manim_layout_audit.py/final_frame_check.py. Self-intro ('Hi, I'm Agrima') opens B00's narration per the user's kickoff. All items are the user's own self-reported account. No footage exists -- every visual is a generated Manim graphic.

props.title: weekly_recap_v1.py
props.code:
WEEK = [
    {"part": "1. Writing",
     "item": "Published my weekly article on Substack: 'Have You Asked the Chatbot About Your Brand Lately?'"},
    {"part": "2. Video production",
     "item": "Two Brutalist videos (AI topic + weekly recap), each in 16:9 and 9:16: four files"},
    {"part": "3. Homes of Hope documentary",
     "item": "Helped Yatra with the poster design"},
    {"part": "4. Organizing the work",
     "item": "AI videos pushed to GitHub; the week's videos attached on Drive"},
]


def log():
    for entry in WEEK:
        print(f"- {entry['part']}: {entry['item']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    log()

beats.narration_text: Same four parts, now with a role. Author. Producer. Support. Organizer.

props.title: weekly_recap_v2.py
props.code:
WEEK = [
    {"role": "author", "part": "1. Writing",
     "item": "Weekly article on Substack: 'Have You Asked the Chatbot About Your Brand Lately?'"},
    {"role": "producer", "part": "2. Video production",
     "item": "Two Brutalist videos, each in 16:9 and 9:16: four files"},
    {"role": "support", "part": "3. Homes of Hope documentary",
     "item": "Poster design, with Yatra"},
    {"role": "organizer", "part": "4. Organizing the work",
     "item": "AI videos on GitHub; the week's videos on Drive"},
]


def log():
    for entry in WEEK:
        print(f"[{entry['role'].upper()}] {entry['part']}: {entry['item']}")
    support = [e for e in WEEK if e["role"] == "support"]
    print(f"{len(WEEK)} parts done, {len(support)} in a supporting role")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    log()
